name: nook-photos
description: Nook Photos — self-hosted photo backup. Cross-platform monorepo (Expo mobile + React web + shared core + Fastify backend).

comments.overrides: konva is pinned so react-konva and react-filerobot-image-editor share ONE copy. Filerobot pins konva 9.3.18 as a direct dep while konva's latest is 10.x; without this, npm hoists 10.x for react-konva and nests 9.3.18 under Filerobot, shipping two Konva runtimes (bundle bloat + reconciler/instance mismatch). react-konva@19.2.5 peers konva ^9 || ^10, so 9.3.18 satisfies both.
